note: one query position `pos` (q is already q_norm'ed and roped; k is k_norm'ed and roped; v is v_norm'ed). k and v hold ALL positions 0..pos (pos+1 rows of kv_heads*head_dim); the query sees keys j with first_visible <= j <= pos, i.e. j > pos - window (window null: all j <= pos). Scaling is 1.0 (no 1/sqrt(d)), no softcap; head h uses KV head h/(heads/kv_heads). y = concatenated per-head contexts, before o_proj. An engine with a window-sized ring cache must give the same y from the last min(window, pos+1) rows.
